name: parapetai-mcp
summary: MCP server for Claude Code (and other MCP clients): device-code login to a Parapet control plane, provisioning agents, and pulling the exact quickstart config a codebase needs -- ships four packaged skills: parapet-maf and parapet-adk (retrofit an existing project, one per framework integration), parapet-quickdemo (generate a runnable identity-based governance demo from nothing), and parapet-install-prereqs (detect and, with per-step approval, install Python/pipx/uv).
author: Parapet
